nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every 15 minutes. Controlled by feature flag: jobbank_connector_enabled

nodes.name: Check Feature Flag
nodes.notes: Fetch feature flag status before doing any work

nodes.name: Flag Gate
nodes.notes: Only continue if flag is enabled. Stops execution silently if disabled.

nodes.name: Log: Connector Started
nodes.notes: Create connector_run record for health monitoring

nodes.name: Build Search URLs
nodes.notes: Generates list of URLs to fetch. Controlled by keyword/location config.

nodes.name: HTTP: Fetch Job Bank Page
nodes.notes: Fetches raw HTML. Runs in loop for each URL from previous node.

nodes.name: INSERT: raw_jobs
nodes.notes: Step 2: Store raw payload in staging table

nodes.name: CHECK: Duplicate?
nodes.notes: Step 3: Check if content_hash already exists (deduplication)

nodes.name: Is New Job?
nodes.notes: If length = 0 → new job. If length > 0 → duplicate, skip.

nodes.name: INSERT: jobs
nodes.notes: Step 4: Insert CanonicalJob into jobs table

nodes.name: INSERT: job_contents
nodes.notes: Store text separately — keeps jobs table light

nodes.name: INSERT: outbox (job.discovered)

parameters.name: p_payload
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ raw_job_id: $('INSERT: raw_jobs').item.json.id, connector: 'jobbank', external_ref: $('Parse → CanonicalJob').item.json.external_id, fetched_at: $('Parse → CanonicalJob').item.json.fetched_at }) }}

nodes.notes: Step 5: Publish via Outbox. Same transaction model — outbox publisher will emit event.
